title: Repair sync custody observation, retired proof credit and push rejection admission
outcome: Sync writers avoid Git under SQL locks, retired imported proof cannot carry completion, and uncertain pushes cannot be reconciled as recorded rejections.
acceptance: Abandoned-carrier Git and data-worktree observations run outside the SQL writer under existing reservations; writer admission compares captured canonical and retained facts and refuses changes without weakening pin, lineage, uncertainty or recovery guards.

A retired imported consumption cannot carry a criterion through an older unrelated native pass. A native replacement obeys shared obligation, source, kind/pin and current-result rules after the required trigger/import positions and becomes the carrier; ordinary historical bindings and original bytes are preserved.

Legacy and delta non-fast-forward resolution and stop require the current start's canonical recorded rejection; interrupted started-but-unknown dispatch refuses while an actual recorded rejection remains usable within the retry budget.

Meaningful focused regressions cover the writer-lock boundary with a second SQLite writer at actual Git queries, no-root retired credit with older and newer native checks, and unknown-start versus recorded-rejection admission. A complete handoff preserves exact source, patch and native check results/counts without changing the frozen parent.

completion.summary: Move abandoned-carrier Git checks outside SQLite writer transactions, require a current native proof after retired imported consumption, and reconcile non-fast-forward only after canonical push rejection. Delivered exact Opus fixture carry on da88414b; four focused checks pass and independent evaluation passes4/4.
